abstract: Project-aware Codex hooks scaffolder that verifies the live official Codex hook docs, open-source schemas, and runtime source, audits a target repository in detail, inspects the canonical `hooks` feature state, and then generates a deterministic command-hook scaffold with one script per current event, repeatable `hooks.json` merges, reusable repo-owned script delegation, trust-review guidance, and a generated hooks README for the target project.
